learner_operation: Normalize a Bernoulli ODE, identify n, apply z=y^(1-n), solve the linear equation with an elementary integrating factor, recover valid real branches and select the resulting general solution. Candidate differentiation is a legitimate alternative mathematical check.

fixed_features.justification: Each source profile teaches a particular substitution and inversion workload; coefficients and forcing signs vary while elementary integration remains comparable.

fixed_features.justification: All ten complete captured practice banks have five math choices. New domain wording makes the divisions and real branches used in the source solutions explicit.

fixed_features.justification: Maintains source-sized elementary powers, avoids resonance/logarithmic branches and keeps hard normalization comparable; does not fix the qualifying formula because coefficient magnitude, forcing sign and target vary.

shortcut_probes.conclusion: Every one of the five visible formulas is correct for one of five controlled displayed equations.
